use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.write_line
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.StringSplitOptions

write("a b: ")

while let entered = read_line() do
    let fields =
        entered.split([' '], StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)

    write_line("{int.parse(fields[0]) + int.parse(fields[1])}")

    write("a b: ")
od

write_line()
